notes.content: Request has been received and acknowledgment sent to requester. Assigned to clerk for initial review.
Initial documents have been collected from police department. Currently reviewing for sensitive information.
Requester called asking for status update. Informed them of current processing stage.
Media request with expedited processing. High priority due to public interest in city council activities.
Fee waiver approved based on news media category. Documents collected and currently under final review.
Requester requested additional clarification on search scope. Will need to follow up with expanded document search.
Academic request completed successfully. All relevant documents provided with appropriate exemptions applied.
Partial grant issued. Some documents withheld under exemptions b3, b4, and b6 as noted in response letter.
Requester expressed satisfaction with response and indicated no appeal will be filed.
Commercial request received. Estimated fees calculated at $150.00 based on expected document volume.
Awaiting payment from requester before proceeding with document collection and review.
